svg.title: Thread profile – gothic arch
svg.text: Thread profile – gothic arch (axial section through one ball, scale 40 : 1)
arc centres (x): offset e = r − Dw/2 = 0.19 mm along the contact line
screw axis 16.5 mm below the ball centre (not shown)
more sliding (spin) → higher friction and heat.
2-point: each ball touches one shaft + one nut
flank; preload comes from the second nut.
Conformity f small (0.52) → high load rating, more
friction; f large (0.56) → low friction, lower C.
